units.title: Verify: Runner lock, worktree and timeout unit tests

tests.name: TestRunLocked
tests.title: Run does not start when the World lock is already held
tests.scenario: Given the lock file exists, When Run is called, Then it returns an error wrapping lock.ErrLocked, the agent is not called and no worktree is created

tests.name: TestRunCleanup
tests.title: A successful run releases the lock and removes its worktree
tests.scenario: Given the agent succeeds, When Run completes, Then the lock file is gone, the worktree WorkRoot/EXEC-1 is created and removed once, and the agent works in that directory

tests.name: TestRunTimeout
tests.title: An agent that exceeds the timeout fails the execution
tests.scenario: Given the agent blocks and the timeout is 20ms, When Run is called, Then it returns an error wrapping context.DeadlineExceeded and the stored EXEC-1 record is FAILED

units.title: Verify: Runner retry and budget unit tests

tests.name: TestRunRetriesThenSucceeds
tests.title: retries a failing agent until it succeeds
tests.scenario: Given MaxRetries is 2 and the agent fails twice before succeeding, When Run is called, Then it returns no error, the agent ran three times and the stored Attempt is 3.

tests.name: TestRunRetryExhausted
tests.title: fails the execution once retries are exhausted
tests.scenario: Given MaxRetries is 1 and the agent fails on every call, When Run is called, Then the agent ran twice, the stored status is FAILED and the stored error contains the second error text.

tests.name: TestRunBudgetExceeded
tests.title: stops retrying once the accumulated cost exceeds the budget
tests.scenario: Given each agent call costs 3.0, MaxBudget is 5.0, MaxRetries is 5 and every call fails, When Run is called, Then it returns an error wrapping ErrBudgetExceeded and the agent ran exactly twice.

attempts.failure: Verify tests failed (3): TestRunRetriesThenSucceeds, TestRunRetryExhausted, TestRunBudgetExceeded

tests.scenario: Given MaxRetries 2 and the agent fails twice then succeeds, When Run is called, Then err is nil, agent.calls is 3 and stored Attempt is 3

tests.name: TestRunBudgetExceeded
tests.title: stops retrying once the cost budget is exceeded

tests.detail: Build failed: undefined ErrBudgetExceeded in runner package. Budget enforcement and the ErrBudgetExceeded sentinel are not implemented in runner.go.

units.title: Verify: Runner approval gate unit tests

tests.name: TestRunGateBlocksPublish
tests.title: Run keeps the execution awaiting approval and does not publish when AutoPublish is off
tests.scenario: Given the agent succeeds and AutoPublish is false, When Run is called, Then the returned and stored status is AWAITING_APPROVAL, the publisher is never called and no worktree is removed

tests.name: TestRunGateAutoPublish
tests.title: Run publishes the work directory once and completes when AutoPublish is on
tests.scenario: Given the agent succeeds and AutoPublish is true, When Run is called, Then the publisher is called exactly once with WorkRoot/EXEC-1 and the stored status is COMPLETED

tests.name: TestRunGatePublishError
tests.title: Run fails the execution and returns the error when publishing fails
tests.scenario: Given the agent succeeds, AutoPublish is true and the publisher fails with boom, When Run is called, Then it returns an error that wraps boom and the stored status is FAILED

attempts.failure: Verify tests failed (3): TestRunGateBlocksPublish, TestRunGateAutoPublish, TestRunGatePublishError

tests.name: TestRunGateBlocksPublish
tests.title: Runner keeps a successful run awaiting approval and does not publish when AutoPublish is off
tests.scenario: Given the agent succeeds and AutoPublish is false, When Run is called, Then the returned and stored status is AWAITING_APPROVAL, the publisher is never called and no worktree is removed.

tests.name: TestRunGateAutoPublish
